english.title: Pilot to take steps before flying display
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the pilot in command of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..) who was intending to participate in a flying display at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), failed to take all reasonable steps to be satisfied, before participating, that

(A)_[the flying display director had been granted an appropriate permission under Article 80(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016]_
(B)_[the intended flight could comply with a relevant condition, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), subject to which an appropriate permission under Article 80(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 had been granted]_
(C)_[you had been granted an appropriate pilot display authorisation]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Article 86(2) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
